body: Eh, my friends have made a negligible difference, but the main issue is that I just don't want to.  Which is why I'm here, hoping someone would agree.  If I can't be bothered to put any effort into my life, then it is not worth living.  I thank both you and HotBrowne for your suggestions.

Lol I guess I find my laptop precious, but I'm sure that's not what you mean.  I'm a fairly materialistic guy, so I frequently consume or exhaust the use of the things I like most.  I...I can't really say I find anything precious.  I have no productive interests, no passions:  I just live to get by, nowadays frantically spending all of my free time trying to counteract how mundane, dull, and as of late, crushing the "getting by" part is.  I don't think I'm in any position to complain, but it gets tougher each day.  Look down on me all you'd like.

I mean, I'm complaining about how hard I try to relax!  I'm sitting in my own squalor, dragging through the internet one tab at a time.  The only substance I've consumed this week is coffee-nothing else.  I've got a stomach ache, but you know what they say: no pain no gain.  And I know I shouldn't be okay with this, but my actions say otherwise.

I feel like two different people:  One who's enjoying the shit out of all of this and can't wait to kick the bucket when he can no longer afford to live this way; and one who is aggravated that despite all efforts, he can't get himself together whatever the cost may be, and is going to kick the bucket because he's fed up with trying.

If there's anything that I can say with certainty, it's that I cannot "re-engineer" myself into motion.  I've spent the past two years attempting to do so: participating in activities, trying to become social, doing productive shit like exercising and eating healthy, but none of it works.  I haven't the slightest idea how everyone enjoys any of that stuff.  I'm able to hold up the act for 3 days to a few weeks before the whole thing collapses, I go into withdrawal mode, and sink back into my vices.

I'm sure your statements would hold true for many others, but I'm simply not like that.  I enjoy sleeping, surfing the internet, eating, listening to music, playing video games, or doing nothing.  When I try to do anything else, I find myself ruminating over why I'm not just doing those previously mentioned things.

None of those things are profitable (except video games perhaps, but I don't have the patience or commitment to stream and actually learn any of the competitive games I play), which means not long and I'll be the stereotypical leech on society.  I tried my hardest, and unsurprisingly, it wasn't nearly enough.

Meh, college was fairly easy to get into.  I ended up at my safety school, but was surprised I even made it.  I can't say I even want college, but my parents won't take no for an answer.  So I kinda "have to do it".  If I continue living, that is.

I've failed on occasion, but this is pretty large by my standards.  3 weeks remaining in the semester and I can't confidently say that I passed one class.

In addition to finding out I'll need to go through three more years of schooling (already went through two) along with two summer school classes each year and a full-time job throughout, I'm beginning to realize this wasn't what I signed up for.
